topics.title: Floating Gallery Concept
topics.body: Galleria presents your photographs as framed artwork mounted on a floating gallery. The landing page features a horizontal slider, and the archive shows a clean grid of framed thumbnails. Wall textures (plaster, linen, concrete) can be changed in the Skin Admin.

topics.title: Galleria and Hip 2 B Square
topics.body: Galleria now carries both sibling looks in one maintained skin. Choose Galleria for the original light gallery, or Hip 2 B Square for the dark teal wall, cyan details, yellow frames, and square archive crops. Changing the look does not move, delete, or replace any photographs, albums, collections, captions, or site settings.

topics.title: Picture Frames
topics.body: Each image is displayed in a photorealistic CSS picture frame with configurable frame colour, frame width, mat colour, mat width, bevel style, and wood grain. Site-wide defaults are set in Skin Admin under PICTURE FRAMES. Per-image overrides can be set on the Edit Transmission page in the Frame & Display section.

topics.title: Colour Palette
topics.body: When you upload an image, SnapSmack automatically extracts 5 dominant colours from the photograph. These appear as clickable swatches on the Edit Transmission page, making it easy to choose a frame or mat colour that complements the image. To generate palettes for images you already had, run php tools/_build/backfill-palettes.php.

topics.title: Slider Settings
topics.body: The landing page slider can show 1, 2, or 3 framed images at a time. Transition speed, auto-advance, and looping are all configurable in Skin Admin under SLIDER. Touch/swipe and keyboard arrows are supported.

topics.title: Archive Grid
topics.body: The archive displays thumbnails in miniature frames matching the hero image framing. Column count (2-6), max width, and side padding are all configurable. Frames can be toggled to plain borders if preferred.

topics.title: Aspect Ratios
topics.body: Galleria supports landscape, portrait, and square photographs. The Force Square Crop control is in Skin Admin under IMAGE CROP and changes archive thumbnails only; it does not alter the source image, frame, mat, or bevel. The Hip 2 B Square look keeps this crop on so its archive stays uniformly square.

topics.title: Likes & Comments
topics.body: SnapSmack ships built-in likes and comments — self-hosted on your own server with no third-party tracking. A heart button lets visitors like a photograph without an account. Comments require a free community account created directly on your site. Manage likes, comments, abuse limits, and comment notification emails in Admin > Community Settings.
